definition: Rank features by evidence of smooth, non-random variation along inferred pseudotime and evaluate whether subsets preserve the full-data neighborhood/trajectory geometry.
assumptions: The dataset contains a dominant continuous progression linked to age/cell-cycle or state transition.
Pseudotime inferred from a nearest-neighbor graph is meaningful for this preprocessed protein imaging dataset.
invariants: Use a cell-cell graph or manifold from the full data to define reference trajectory structure.
Score features using association with pseudotime and smoothness across neighboring cells.
Evaluate selected subsets against baselines on trajectory preservation metrics.
non_negotiable_steps: Infer low-dimensional manifold/neighborhood graph from full feature matrix.
Estimate pseudotime rooted at early-state cells.
Compare subset preservation versus variance/random baselines across subset sizes.
